solutions.title: Recursive middle split
solutions.strategy: Choose the middle value as root and recursively build left and right halves.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every input value becomes exactly one tree node.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The constructed tree is balanced, so recursion depth is logarithmic.

solutions.title: Iterative segment queue
solutions.strategy: Create root nodes for array segments in queue order and attach each child segment to its parent.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value is turned into one node and each segment is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue can hold pending child segments across a level.
